title: Motorola Talkabout T82 Extreme Walkie Talkies 2-Pack — 16 Channels, IPX4, Camping
short_description: Motorola Talkabout T82 Extreme PMR446 walkie talkies in a twin pack with 16 channels, IPX4 and a backlit display — for camping and hiking.
long_description: According to Amazon, the Motorola Talkabout T82 Extreme Twin Pack (manufacturer part number B8P00810YDEMAG) contains two PMR446 walkie talkies with 16 channels in the 446 MHz band. The devices are IPX4 rated according to Amazon (water resistant), with a backlit display and a wrist strap. They run on 2 AA batteries, which Amazon lists as included. The average battery life is stated as 16 hours. One unit measures 3.3 x 5.7 x 18.1 cm and weighs 190 g according to Amazon. Amazon states a maximum range of 10 kilometres. The actual range depends heavily on terrain and surroundings. Please check the exact scope of delivery on the Amazon product page and the rules for using PMR446 devices in your country before buying.
features: PMR446 walkie talkies in a twin pack
buying_angle: Handy for campers, hikers and families who want to stay in touch on the campsite or on the trail without mobile coverage.
